paras: 04 Days Delhi, Agra & Jaipur Tour Package
Tour Code #DR075
Rs.7999/- per person
Day 1: Arrival in Delhi
Once you will reach Delhi, you will be warmly welcomed by our representative at the railway station or airport. We will then start our journey to explore the stunning attractions of Delhi:
Red Fort: A symbol rich history.
Purana Qila: An antique fort with a fascinating past.
Jama Masjid: One of the largest mosques in India.
Qutab Minar: A towering architectural marvel.
India Gate: A tribute to Indian soldiers.
Chandni Chowk: A bustling market full of vibrant energy.
Lakshmi Narayan Temple: A beautiful temple dedicated to Lord Vishnu.
After that, we will proceed to Agra. Upon arrival, check in at your hotel for an overnight stay.
Day 2: Agra to Jaipur
After having your breakfast, we will explore the magnificentplaces of Agra:
Taj Mahal: The iconic symbol of love.
Agra Fort: A majestic fort with historical meaning.
Itimad-Ud-Daulah: Normally known by the name of "Baby Taj."
Markets & Bazaars: Experience the scene of local shopping.
In the time of afternoon, we will head to Jaipur. Upon arrival, check in at your hotel for an overnight stay.
Day 3: Sightseeing in Jaipur
After breakfast, we will explore the enchanting "Pink City" of Jaipur, visiting:
Hawa Mahal: The famous "Palace of Winds."
City Palace: A stunning blend of Rajasthani and Mughal architecture.
Observatory / Jantar Mantar: Aremarkable collection of planetary instruments.
Jal Mahal: The beautiful "Water Palace."
Amer Fort: A majestic fort with stunning views.
Nahargarh Fort: Offering panoramic views of the city.
Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.
Day 4: Jaipur Departure
After breakfast, we will drop you off at Jaipur railway station or airport for your departure. This marks the end of a memorable tour. Happy and Safe travels!
Package Inclusions:
* Daily breakfast
